model.module_text:
---- MODULE LatestCompile ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxJobs, MaxCancels, MaxDeliveries
VARIABLES status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent

vars == <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent>>

\* This is an UNRATIFIED, bounded, per-fork candidate for the unchanged hook.
\* An action is one synchronous public call or callback, after React updates flush.
\* Worker construction/termination and timer installation/clearing are recorded
\* inside that action. overlapSeen records even a transient overlap of workers.
\* A driver assigns each compile a distinct source and payload tag j.
\* resultJob/resultSource and failureJob/failureSource are those observed tags;
\* zero denotes null. Results persist across compile, cancel, and failures.
\* generation and jobGeneration are the observed ref and captured closure IDs.
\* endings counts terminal updates, deliveries counts invoked terminal callbacks,
\* and handlers/posted record which callbacks exist and which workers got input.
\* staleChanged and mismatchChanged are trace monitors: compare status, result
\* and failure before/after an invalid callback; once a change occurs, retain it.
\* liveWorkers/liveTimers track actual resources, independently of the refs.
\* MaxDeliveries bounds terminal-callback invocations PER job, not invalid-envelope
\* messages. One delivery in F2/F3 isolates those forks without deciding F1.
\* Cleanup and synchronous setup exceptions are absent unless that fork models
\* them. Such partial previews do not settle either of the other questions.
\* Illustrated option: F1/A; no other unanswered fork is chosen.

DeliveryPolicy == "single"
CleanupPolicy == "omitted"
SetupPolicy == "omitted"

Jobs == 1..MaxJobs
MaxGeneration == MaxJobs + MaxCancels + 1
Statuses == {"idle", "compiling", "done", "error", "timeout"}
Outcomes == {"done", "compileError", "environmentError", "workerError", "timeout"}
Events == Outcomes \cup {"init", "compile", "cancel", "cleanup", "stale", "duplicate", "mismatch", "constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
Kind(k) == IF k = "compileError" THEN "compile" ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "environment"

CurrentExists == \E j \in 1..started : jobGeneration[j] = generation
CurrentPending ==
    IF started = 0 THEN FALSE
    ELSE jobGeneration[started] = generation /\ endings[started] = 0 /\ started \notin setupFailed

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in Statuses
    /\ resultJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ resultSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureKind \in {"none", "compile", "environment", "timeout"}
    /\ generation \in 0..MaxGeneration
    /\ started \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ cancellations \in 0..MaxCancels
    /\ cleanupUsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ jobGeneration \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxGeneration]
    /\ handlers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ posted \subseteq Jobs
    /\ workerRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveWorkers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ timeoutRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveTimers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ endings \in [Jobs -> 0..2]
    /\ deliveries \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxDeliveries]
    /\ released \subseteq Jobs
    /\ setupFailed \subseteq Jobs
    /\ staleChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ mismatchChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ overlapSeen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ lastEvent \in Events

LatestOutcomeOnly == ~staleChanged
MatchingMessageOnly == ~mismatchChanged
OneLiveWorker == ~overlapSeen /\ Cardinality(liveWorkers) <= 1
StoppedHasNoWorker == status # "compiling" => liveWorkers = {}
EndedTimerCleared == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0 => j \notin liveTimers /\ timeoutRef # j
CancellationIsIdle ==
    (cancellations > 0 \/ (CleanupPolicy = "cancel" /\ cleanupUsed)) /\ ~CurrentExists
    => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ failureSource = 0 /\ failureKind = "none"
ResourceRefsMatch ==
    /\ liveWorkers = (IF workerRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {workerRef})
    /\ liveTimers = (IF timeoutRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {timeoutRef})
PayloadSourcesMatch ==
    /\ resultSource = resultJob
    /\ failureSource = failureJob
    /\ (failureJob = 0) = (failureKind = "none")
ExactlyOneEnding == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] <= 1
CleanupCancels ==
    lastEvent = "cleanup" => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ ~CurrentExists
SetupErrorsReported ==
    /\ lastEvent \in {"constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
       => status = "error" /\ failureJob = started /\ failureKind = "environment"
          /\ workerRef = 0 /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ \A j \in setupFailed : endings[j] = 1

UnreplacedEventuallyEnds ==
    \A j \in Jobs :
        (j <= started /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation /\ endings[j] = 0
         /\ j \notin released /\ j \notin setupFailed)
        ~> (endings[j] > 0 \/ jobGeneration[j] # generation
            \/ j \in released \/ j \in setupFailed)

CanCompile == status = "compiling" /\ workerRef # 0 /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanSucceed == status = "done" /\ resultJob # 0
CanFailCompilation == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "compile"
CanFailEnvironment == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanTimeOut == status = "timeout" /\ failureKind = "timeout"
CanCancel == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ handlers # {}
CanReplace == started = MaxJobs /\ status = "compiling"
CanIgnoreStale == lastEvent = "stale"
CanIgnoreMismatch == lastEvent = "mismatch"
CanRetainResult == status = "compiling" /\ resultJob > 0 /\ resultJob < started
CanCancelAfterFailure == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0
CanIgnoreDuplicate == lastEvent = "duplicate" /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] = 1
CanAbandonOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "compiling" /\ released # {} /\ liveTimers = {}
CanApplyAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ status = "done" /\ resultJob \in released
CanCancelOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "idle" /\ handlers # {} /\ ~CurrentExists
CanRejectAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ lastEvent = "stale" /\ cancellations = 0 /\ started = 1
CanThrowConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ started \in setupFailed /\ workerRef = 0
CanThrowPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "compiling" /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanTimeOutAfterPostThrow == status = "timeout" /\ failureJob \in handlers \ posted
CanReportConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanReportPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"

Init ==
    /\ status = "idle"
    /\ resultJob = 0
    /\ resultSource = 0
    /\ failureJob = 0
    /\ failureSource = 0
    /\ failureKind = "none"
    /\ generation = 0
    /\ started = 0
    /\ cancellations = 0
    /\ cleanupUsed = FALSE
    /\ jobGeneration = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ handlers = {}
    /\ posted = {}
    /\ workerRef = 0
    /\ liveWorkers = {}
    /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ liveTimers = {}
    /\ endings = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ deliveries = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ released = {}
    /\ setupFailed = {}
    /\ staleChanged = FALSE
    /\ mismatchChanged = FALSE
    /\ overlapSeen = FALSE
    /\ lastEvent = "init"

Compile(j) ==
    /\ j = started + 1
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ started' = j
    /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
    /\ status' = "compiling"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ workerRef' = j
    /\ liveWorkers' = {j}
    /\ timeoutRef' = j
    /\ liveTimers' = {j}
    /\ handlers' = handlers \cup {j}
    /\ posted' = posted \cup {j}
    /\ lastEvent' = "compile"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, cancellations, cleanupUsed, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

Cancel ==
    /\ cancellations < MaxCancels
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ cancellations' = cancellations + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ lastEvent' = "cancel"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, started, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

DeliverOutcome(j, k) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ (k \in {"workerError", "timeout"} \/ j \in posted)
    /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
    /\ (DeliveryPolicy # "guarded" \/ endings[j] = 0)
    /\ (SetupPolicy # "report" \/ j \notin setupFailed)
    /\ endings[j] < 2
    /\ status' = IF k = "done" THEN "done" ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "error"
    /\ resultJob' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultJob
    /\ resultSource' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultSource
    /\ failureJob' = IF k = "done" THEN failureJob ELSE j
    /\ failureSource' = IF k = "done" THEN failureSource ELSE j
    /\ failureKind' = IF k = "done" THEN failureKind ELSE Kind(k)
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

IgnoreOutcome(j, k) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ (k \in {"workerError", "timeout"} \/ j \in posted)
    /\ (jobGeneration[j] # generation \/ (DeliveryPolicy = "guarded" /\ endings[j] > 0) \/ (SetupPolicy = "report" /\ j \in setupFailed))
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = IF jobGeneration[j] # generation THEN "stale" ELSE "duplicate"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

WrongEnvelope(j) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ lastEvent' = "mismatch"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

\* Advancing the installed timer is a system scheduler step, not a demand
\* for a user or worker to respond. It models eventual delivery of the deadline.
Timeout(j) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ timeoutRef = j
    /\ j \in liveTimers
    /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
    /\ endings[j] = 0
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ status' = "timeout"
    /\ resultJob' = resultJob
    /\ resultSource' = resultSource
    /\ failureJob' = j
    /\ failureSource' = j
    /\ failureKind' = "timeout"
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = "timeout"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

DeadlineFairness == \A j \in Jobs : WF_vars(Timeout(j))

\* Finite exploration may stop taking public calls; timers still have fairness.
Quiesce == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ (\E j \in Jobs : Compile(j) \/ WrongEnvelope(j) \/ Timeout(j))
    \/ (\E j \in Jobs, k \in Outcomes : DeliverOutcome(j, k) \/ IgnoreOutcome(j, k))
    \/ Cancel
    \/ Quiesce

\* Mutations exercise trace monitors and resource observations, not real code.
ApplyStaleCallback ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ jobGeneration[j] # generation
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ endings[j] < 2
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveTimers' = {}
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

AcceptWrongEnvelope ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ j \in posted
        /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
        /\ endings[j] = 0
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveTimers' = {}
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = staleChanged
        /\ mismatchChanged' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, overlapSeen>>

SpawnBeforeTerminate ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j = started + 1
        /\ liveWorkers # {}
        /\ generation' = generation + 1
        /\ started' = j
        /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
        /\ status' = "compiling"
        /\ failureJob' = 0
        /\ failureSource' = 0
        /\ failureKind' = "none"
        /\ workerRef' = j
        /\ liveWorkers' = {j}
        /\ timeoutRef' = j
        /\ liveTimers' = {j}
        /\ handlers' = handlers \cup {j}
        /\ posted' = posted \cup {j}
        /\ lastEvent' = "compile"
        /\ overlapSeen' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, cancellations, cleanupUsed, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged>>

CancelKeepsFailure ==
    /\ cancellations < MaxCancels
    /\ failureJob # 0
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ cancellations' = cancellations + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failureJob' = failureJob
    /\ failureSource' = failureSource
    /\ failureKind' = failureKind
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ lastEvent' = "cancel"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, started, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

FinishWithoutClearingTimer ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
        /\ endings[j] = 0
        /\ timeoutRef = j
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = timeoutRef
        /\ liveTimers' = liveTimers
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = staleChanged
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

model.module_text:
---- MODULE LatestCompile ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxJobs, MaxCancels, MaxDeliveries
VARIABLES status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent

vars == <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent>>

\* This is an UNRATIFIED, bounded, per-fork candidate for the unchanged hook.
\* An action is one synchronous public call or callback, after React updates flush.
\* Worker construction/termination and timer installation/clearing are recorded
\* inside that action. overlapSeen records even a transient overlap of workers.
\* A driver assigns each compile a distinct source and payload tag j.
\* resultJob/resultSource and failureJob/failureSource are those observed tags;
\* zero denotes null. Results persist across compile, cancel, and failures.
\* generation and jobGeneration are the observed ref and captured closure IDs.
\* endings counts terminal updates, deliveries counts invoked terminal callbacks,
\* and handlers/posted record which callbacks exist and which workers got input.
\* staleChanged and mismatchChanged are trace monitors: compare status, result
\* and failure before/after an invalid callback; once a change occurs, retain it.
\* liveWorkers/liveTimers track actual resources, independently of the refs.
\* MaxDeliveries bounds terminal-callback invocations PER job, not invalid-envelope
\* messages. One delivery in F2/F3 isolates those forks without deciding F1.
\* Cleanup and synchronous setup exceptions are absent unless that fork models
\* them. Such partial previews do not settle either of the other questions.
\* Illustrated option: F1/B; no other unanswered fork is chosen.

DeliveryPolicy == "guarded"
CleanupPolicy == "omitted"
SetupPolicy == "omitted"

Jobs == 1..MaxJobs
MaxGeneration == MaxJobs + MaxCancels + 1
Statuses == {"idle", "compiling", "done", "error", "timeout"}
Outcomes == {"done", "compileError", "environmentError", "workerError", "timeout"}
Events == Outcomes \cup {"init", "compile", "cancel", "cleanup", "stale", "duplicate", "mismatch", "constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
Kind(k) == IF k = "compileError" THEN "compile" ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "environment"

CurrentExists == \E j \in 1..started : jobGeneration[j] = generation
CurrentPending ==
    IF started = 0 THEN FALSE
    ELSE jobGeneration[started] = generation /\ endings[started] = 0 /\ started \notin setupFailed

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in Statuses
    /\ resultJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ resultSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureKind \in {"none", "compile", "environment", "timeout"}
    /\ generation \in 0..MaxGeneration
    /\ started \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ cancellations \in 0..MaxCancels
    /\ cleanupUsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ jobGeneration \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxGeneration]
    /\ handlers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ posted \subseteq Jobs
    /\ workerRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveWorkers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ timeoutRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveTimers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ endings \in [Jobs -> 0..2]
    /\ deliveries \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxDeliveries]
    /\ released \subseteq Jobs
    /\ setupFailed \subseteq Jobs
    /\ staleChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ mismatchChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ overlapSeen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ lastEvent \in Events

LatestOutcomeOnly == ~staleChanged
MatchingMessageOnly == ~mismatchChanged
OneLiveWorker == ~overlapSeen /\ Cardinality(liveWorkers) <= 1
StoppedHasNoWorker == status # "compiling" => liveWorkers = {}
EndedTimerCleared == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0 => j \notin liveTimers /\ timeoutRef # j
CancellationIsIdle ==
    (cancellations > 0 \/ (CleanupPolicy = "cancel" /\ cleanupUsed)) /\ ~CurrentExists
    => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ failureSource = 0 /\ failureKind = "none"
ResourceRefsMatch ==
    /\ liveWorkers = (IF workerRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {workerRef})
    /\ liveTimers = (IF timeoutRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {timeoutRef})
PayloadSourcesMatch ==
    /\ resultSource = resultJob
    /\ failureSource = failureJob
    /\ (failureJob = 0) = (failureKind = "none")
ExactlyOneEnding == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] <= 1
CleanupCancels ==
    lastEvent = "cleanup" => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ ~CurrentExists
SetupErrorsReported ==
    /\ lastEvent \in {"constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
       => status = "error" /\ failureJob = started /\ failureKind = "environment"
          /\ workerRef = 0 /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ \A j \in setupFailed : endings[j] = 1

UnreplacedEventuallyEnds ==
    \A j \in Jobs :
        (j <= started /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation /\ endings[j] = 0
         /\ j \notin released /\ j \notin setupFailed)
        ~> (endings[j] > 0 \/ jobGeneration[j] # generation
            \/ j \in released \/ j \in setupFailed)

CanCompile == status = "compiling" /\ workerRef # 0 /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanSucceed == status = "done" /\ resultJob # 0
CanFailCompilation == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "compile"
CanFailEnvironment == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanTimeOut == status = "timeout" /\ failureKind = "timeout"
CanCancel == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ handlers # {}
CanReplace == started = MaxJobs /\ status = "compiling"
CanIgnoreStale == lastEvent = "stale"
CanIgnoreMismatch == lastEvent = "mismatch"
CanRetainResult == status = "compiling" /\ resultJob > 0 /\ resultJob < started
CanCancelAfterFailure == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0
CanIgnoreDuplicate == lastEvent = "duplicate" /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] = 1
CanAbandonOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "compiling" /\ released # {} /\ liveTimers = {}
CanApplyAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ status = "done" /\ resultJob \in released
CanCancelOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "idle" /\ handlers # {} /\ ~CurrentExists
CanRejectAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ lastEvent = "stale" /\ cancellations = 0 /\ started = 1
CanThrowConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ started \in setupFailed /\ workerRef = 0
CanThrowPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "compiling" /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanTimeOutAfterPostThrow == status = "timeout" /\ failureJob \in handlers \ posted
CanReportConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanReportPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"

Init ==
    /\ status = "idle"
    /\ resultJob = 0
    /\ resultSource = 0
    /\ failureJob = 0
    /\ failureSource = 0
    /\ failureKind = "none"
    /\ generation = 0
    /\ started = 0
    /\ cancellations = 0
    /\ cleanupUsed = FALSE
    /\ jobGeneration = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ handlers = {}
    /\ posted = {}
    /\ workerRef = 0
    /\ liveWorkers = {}
    /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ liveTimers = {}
    /\ endings = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ deliveries = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ released = {}
    /\ setupFailed = {}
    /\ staleChanged = FALSE
    /\ mismatchChanged = FALSE
    /\ overlapSeen = FALSE
    /\ lastEvent = "init"

Compile(j) ==
    /\ j = started + 1
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ started' = j
    /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
    /\ status' = "compiling"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ workerRef' = j
    /\ liveWorkers' = {j}
    /\ timeoutRef' = j
    /\ liveTimers' = {j}
    /\ handlers' = handlers \cup {j}
    /\ posted' = posted \cup {j}
    /\ lastEvent' = "compile"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, cancellations, cleanupUsed, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

Cancel ==
    /\ cancellations < MaxCancels
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ cancellations' = cancellations + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ lastEvent' = "cancel"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, started, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

DeliverOutcome(j, k) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ (k \in {"workerError", "timeout"} \/ j \in posted)
    /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
    /\ (DeliveryPolicy # "guarded" \/ endings[j] = 0)
    /\ (SetupPolicy # "report" \/ j \notin setupFailed)
    /\ endings[j] < 2
    /\ status' = IF k = "done" THEN "done" ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "error"
    /\ resultJob' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultJob
    /\ resultSource' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultSource
    /\ failureJob' = IF k = "done" THEN failureJob ELSE j
    /\ failureSource' = IF k = "done" THEN failureSource ELSE j
    /\ failureKind' = IF k = "done" THEN failureKind ELSE Kind(k)
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

IgnoreOutcome(j, k) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ (k \in {"workerError", "timeout"} \/ j \in posted)
    /\ (jobGeneration[j] # generation \/ (DeliveryPolicy = "guarded" /\ endings[j] > 0) \/ (SetupPolicy = "report" /\ j \in setupFailed))
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = IF jobGeneration[j] # generation THEN "stale" ELSE "duplicate"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

WrongEnvelope(j) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ lastEvent' = "mismatch"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

\* Advancing the installed timer is a system scheduler step, not a demand
\* for a user or worker to respond. It models eventual delivery of the deadline.
Timeout(j) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ timeoutRef = j
    /\ j \in liveTimers
    /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
    /\ endings[j] = 0
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ status' = "timeout"
    /\ resultJob' = resultJob
    /\ resultSource' = resultSource
    /\ failureJob' = j
    /\ failureSource' = j
    /\ failureKind' = "timeout"
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = "timeout"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

DeadlineFairness == \A j \in Jobs : WF_vars(Timeout(j))

\* Finite exploration may stop taking public calls; timers still have fairness.
Quiesce == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ (\E j \in Jobs : Compile(j) \/ WrongEnvelope(j) \/ Timeout(j))
    \/ (\E j \in Jobs, k \in Outcomes : DeliverOutcome(j, k) \/ IgnoreOutcome(j, k))
    \/ Cancel
    \/ Quiesce

\* Mutations exercise trace monitors and resource observations, not real code.
ApplyStaleCallback ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ jobGeneration[j] # generation
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ endings[j] < 2
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveTimers' = {}
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

AcceptWrongEnvelope ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ j \in posted
        /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
        /\ endings[j] = 0
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveTimers' = {}
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = staleChanged
        /\ mismatchChanged' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, overlapSeen>>

SpawnBeforeTerminate ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j = started + 1
        /\ liveWorkers # {}
        /\ generation' = generation + 1
        /\ started' = j
        /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
        /\ status' = "compiling"
        /\ failureJob' = 0
        /\ failureSource' = 0
        /\ failureKind' = "none"
        /\ workerRef' = j
        /\ liveWorkers' = {j}
        /\ timeoutRef' = j
        /\ liveTimers' = {j}
        /\ handlers' = handlers \cup {j}
        /\ posted' = posted \cup {j}
        /\ lastEvent' = "compile"
        /\ overlapSeen' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, cancellations, cleanupUsed, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged>>

CancelKeepsFailure ==
    /\ cancellations < MaxCancels
    /\ failureJob # 0
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ cancellations' = cancellations + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failureJob' = failureJob
    /\ failureSource' = failureSource
    /\ failureKind' = failureKind
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ lastEvent' = "cancel"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, started, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

FinishWithoutClearingTimer ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
        /\ endings[j] = 0
        /\ timeoutRef = j
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = timeoutRef
        /\ liveTimers' = liveTimers
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = staleChanged
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

ApplySecondOutcome ==

---- MODULE LatestCompile ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxJobs, MaxCancels, MaxDeliveries
VARIABLES status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent

vars == <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent>>

\* This is an UNRATIFIED, bounded, per-fork candidate for the unchanged hook.
\* An action is one synchronous public call or callback, after React updates flush.
\* Worker construction/termination and timer installation/clearing are recorded
\* inside that action. overlapSeen records even a transient overlap of workers.
\* A driver assigns each compile a distinct source and payload tag j.
\* resultJob/resultSource and failureJob/failureSource are those observed tags;
\* zero denotes null. Results persist across compile, cancel, and failures.
\* generation and jobGeneration are the observed ref and captured closure IDs.
\* endings counts terminal updates, deliveries counts invoked terminal callbacks,
\* and handlers/posted record which callbacks exist and which workers got input.
\* staleChanged and mismatchChanged are trace monitors: compare status, result
\* and failure before/after an invalid callback; once a change occurs, retain it.
\* liveWorkers/liveTimers track actual resources, independently of the refs.
\* MaxDeliveries bounds terminal-callback invocations PER job, not invalid-envelope
\* messages. One delivery in F2/F3 isolates those forks without deciding F1.
\* Cleanup and synchronous setup exceptions are absent unless that fork models
\* them. Such partial previews do not settle either of the other questions.
\* Illustrated option: F2/A; no other unanswered fork is chosen.

DeliveryPolicy == "prefix"
CleanupPolicy == "release"
SetupPolicy == "omitted"

Jobs == 1..MaxJobs
MaxGeneration == MaxJobs + MaxCancels + 1
Statuses == {"idle", "compiling", "done", "error", "timeout"}
Outcomes == {"done", "compileError", "environmentError", "workerError", "timeout"}
Events == Outcomes \cup {"init", "compile", "cancel", "cleanup", "stale", "duplicate", "mismatch", "constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
Kind(k) == IF k = "compileError" THEN "compile" ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "environment"

CurrentExists == \E j \in 1..started : jobGeneration[j] = generation
CurrentPending ==
    IF started = 0 THEN FALSE
    ELSE jobGeneration[started] = generation /\ endings[started] = 0 /\ started \notin setupFailed

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in Statuses
    /\ resultJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ resultSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureKind \in {"none", "compile", "environment", "timeout"}
    /\ generation \in 0..MaxGeneration
    /\ started \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ cancellations \in 0..MaxCancels
    /\ cleanupUsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ jobGeneration \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxGeneration]
    /\ handlers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ posted \subseteq Jobs
    /\ workerRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveWorkers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ timeoutRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveTimers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ endings \in [Jobs -> 0..2]
    /\ deliveries \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxDeliveries]
    /\ released \subseteq Jobs
    /\ setupFailed \subseteq Jobs
    /\ staleChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ mismatchChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ overlapSeen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ lastEvent \in Events

LatestOutcomeOnly == ~staleChanged
MatchingMessageOnly == ~mismatchChanged
OneLiveWorker == ~overlapSeen /\ Cardinality(liveWorkers) <= 1
StoppedHasNoWorker == status # "compiling" => liveWorkers = {}
EndedTimerCleared == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0 => j \notin liveTimers /\ timeoutRef # j
CancellationIsIdle ==
    (cancellations > 0 \/ (CleanupPolicy = "cancel" /\ cleanupUsed)) /\ ~CurrentExists
    => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ failureSource = 0 /\ failureKind = "none"
ResourceRefsMatch ==
    /\ liveWorkers = (IF workerRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {workerRef})
    /\ liveTimers = (IF timeoutRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {timeoutRef})
PayloadSourcesMatch ==
    /\ resultSource = resultJob
    /\ failureSource = failureJob
    /\ (failureJob = 0) = (failureKind = "none")
ExactlyOneEnding == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] <= 1
CleanupCancels ==
    lastEvent = "cleanup" => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ ~CurrentExists
SetupErrorsReported ==
    /\ lastEvent \in {"constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
       => status = "error" /\ failureJob = started /\ failureKind = "environment"
          /\ workerRef = 0 /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ \A j \in setupFailed : endings[j] = 1

UnreplacedEventuallyEnds ==
    \A j \in Jobs :
        (j <= started /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation /\ endings[j] = 0
         /\ j \notin released /\ j \notin setupFailed)
        ~> (endings[j] > 0 \/ jobGeneration[j] # generation
            \/ j \in released \/ j \in setupFailed)

CanCompile == status = "compiling" /\ workerRef # 0 /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanSucceed == status = "done" /\ resultJob # 0
CanFailCompilation == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "compile"
CanFailEnvironment == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanTimeOut == status = "timeout" /\ failureKind = "timeout"
CanCancel == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ handlers # {}
CanReplace == started = MaxJobs /\ status = "compiling"
CanIgnoreStale == lastEvent = "stale"
CanIgnoreMismatch == lastEvent = "mismatch"
CanRetainResult == status = "compiling" /\ resultJob > 0 /\ resultJob < started
CanCancelAfterFailure == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0
CanIgnoreDuplicate == lastEvent = "duplicate" /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] = 1
CanAbandonOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "compiling" /\ released # {} /\ liveTimers = {}
CanApplyAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ status = "done" /\ resultJob \in released
CanCancelOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "idle" /\ handlers # {} /\ ~CurrentExists
CanRejectAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ lastEvent = "stale" /\ cancellations = 0 /\ started = 1
CanThrowConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ started \in setupFailed /\ workerRef = 0
CanThrowPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "compiling" /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanTimeOutAfterPostThrow == status = "timeout" /\ failureJob \in handlers \ posted
CanReportConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanReportPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"

    /\ status = "idle"
    /\ resultJob = 0
    /\ resultSource = 0
    /\ failureJob = 0
    /\ failureSource = 0
    /\ failureKind = "none"
    /\ generation = 0

    /\ handlers = {}

    /\ lastEvent = "init"

    /\ started' = j

    /\ status' = "compiling"
    /\ failureJob' = 0

    /\ lastEvent' = "cancel"

DeliverOutcome(j, k) ==

    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ (k \in {"workerError", "timeout"} \/ j \in posted)
    /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation

    /\ resultJob' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultJob
    /\ resultSource' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultSource
    /\ failureJob' = IF k = "done" THEN failureJob ELSE j
    /\ failureSource' = IF k = "done" THEN failureSource ELSE j

    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = k

model.module_text:
---- MODULE LatestCompile ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxJobs, MaxCancels, MaxDeliveries
VARIABLES status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent

vars == <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent>>

\* This is an UNRATIFIED, bounded, per-fork candidate for the unchanged hook.
\* An action is one synchronous public call or callback, after React updates flush.
\* Worker construction/termination and timer installation/clearing are recorded
\* inside that action. overlapSeen records even a transient overlap of workers.
\* A driver assigns each compile a distinct source and payload tag j.
\* resultJob/resultSource and failureJob/failureSource are those observed tags;
\* zero denotes null. Results persist across compile, cancel, and failures.
\* generation and jobGeneration are the observed ref and captured closure IDs.
\* endings counts terminal updates, deliveries counts invoked terminal callbacks,
\* and handlers/posted record which callbacks exist and which workers got input.
\* staleChanged and mismatchChanged are trace monitors: compare status, result
\* and failure before/after an invalid callback; once a change occurs, retain it.
\* liveWorkers/liveTimers track actual resources, independently of the refs.
\* MaxDeliveries bounds terminal-callback invocations PER job, not invalid-envelope
\* messages. One delivery in F2/F3 isolates those forks without deciding F1.
\* Cleanup and synchronous setup exceptions are absent unless that fork models
\* them. Such partial previews do not settle either of the other questions.
\* Illustrated option: F2/B; no other unanswered fork is chosen.

DeliveryPolicy == "prefix"
CleanupPolicy == "cancel"
SetupPolicy == "omitted"

Jobs == 1..MaxJobs
MaxGeneration == MaxJobs + MaxCancels + 1
Statuses == {"idle", "compiling", "done", "error", "timeout"}
Outcomes == {"done", "compileError", "environmentError", "workerError", "timeout"}
Events == Outcomes \cup {"init", "compile", "cancel", "cleanup", "stale", "duplicate", "mismatch", "constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
Kind(k) == IF k = "compileError" THEN "compile" ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "environment"

CurrentExists == \E j \in 1..started : jobGeneration[j] = generation
CurrentPending ==
    IF started = 0 THEN FALSE
    ELSE jobGeneration[started] = generation /\ endings[started] = 0 /\ started \notin setupFailed

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in Statuses
    /\ resultJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ resultSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureKind \in {"none", "compile", "environment", "timeout"}
    /\ generation \in 0..MaxGeneration
    /\ started \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ cancellations \in 0..MaxCancels
    /\ cleanupUsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ jobGeneration \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxGeneration]
    /\ handlers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ posted \subseteq Jobs
    /\ workerRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveWorkers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ timeoutRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveTimers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ endings \in [Jobs -> 0..2]
    /\ deliveries \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxDeliveries]
    /\ released \subseteq Jobs
    /\ setupFailed \subseteq Jobs
    /\ staleChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ mismatchChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ overlapSeen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ lastEvent \in Events

LatestOutcomeOnly == ~staleChanged
MatchingMessageOnly == ~mismatchChanged
OneLiveWorker == ~overlapSeen /\ Cardinality(liveWorkers) <= 1
StoppedHasNoWorker == status # "compiling" => liveWorkers = {}
EndedTimerCleared == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0 => j \notin liveTimers /\ timeoutRef # j
CancellationIsIdle ==
    (cancellations > 0 \/ (CleanupPolicy = "cancel" /\ cleanupUsed)) /\ ~CurrentExists
    => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ failureSource = 0 /\ failureKind = "none"
ResourceRefsMatch ==
    /\ liveWorkers = (IF workerRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {workerRef})
    /\ liveTimers = (IF timeoutRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {timeoutRef})
PayloadSourcesMatch ==
    /\ resultSource = resultJob
    /\ failureSource = failureJob
    /\ (failureJob = 0) = (failureKind = "none")
ExactlyOneEnding == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] <= 1
CleanupCancels ==
    lastEvent = "cleanup" => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ ~CurrentExists
SetupErrorsReported ==
    /\ lastEvent \in {"constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
       => status = "error" /\ failureJob = started /\ failureKind = "environment"
          /\ workerRef = 0 /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ \A j \in setupFailed : endings[j] = 1

UnreplacedEventuallyEnds ==
    \A j \in Jobs :
        (j <= started /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation /\ endings[j] = 0
         /\ j \notin released /\ j \notin setupFailed)
        ~> (endings[j] > 0 \/ jobGeneration[j] # generation
            \/ j \in released \/ j \in setupFailed)

CanCompile == status = "compiling" /\ workerRef # 0 /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanSucceed == status = "done" /\ resultJob # 0
CanFailCompilation == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "compile"
CanFailEnvironment == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanTimeOut == status = "timeout" /\ failureKind = "timeout"
CanCancel == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ handlers # {}
CanReplace == started = MaxJobs /\ status = "compiling"
CanIgnoreStale == lastEvent = "stale"
CanIgnoreMismatch == lastEvent = "mismatch"
CanRetainResult == status = "compiling" /\ resultJob > 0 /\ resultJob < started
CanCancelAfterFailure == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0
CanIgnoreDuplicate == lastEvent = "duplicate" /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] = 1
CanAbandonOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "compiling" /\ released # {} /\ liveTimers = {}
CanApplyAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ status = "done" /\ resultJob \in released
CanCancelOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "idle" /\ handlers # {} /\ ~CurrentExists
CanRejectAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ lastEvent = "stale" /\ cancellations = 0 /\ started = 1
CanThrowConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ started \in setupFailed /\ workerRef = 0
CanThrowPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "compiling" /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanTimeOutAfterPostThrow == status = "timeout" /\ failureJob \in handlers \ posted
CanReportConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanReportPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"

Init ==
    /\ status = "idle"
    /\ resultJob = 0
    /\ resultSource = 0
    /\ failureJob = 0
    /\ failureSource = 0
    /\ failureKind = "none"
    /\ generation = 0
    /\ started = 0
    /\ cancellations = 0
    /\ cleanupUsed = FALSE
    /\ jobGeneration = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ handlers = {}
    /\ posted = {}
    /\ workerRef = 0
    /\ liveWorkers = {}
    /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ liveTimers = {}
    /\ endings = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ deliveries = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ released = {}
    /\ setupFailed = {}
    /\ staleChanged = FALSE
    /\ mismatchChanged = FALSE
    /\ overlapSeen = FALSE
    /\ lastEvent = "init"

Compile(j) ==
    /\ j = started + 1
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ started' = j
    /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
    /\ status' = "compiling"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ workerRef' = j
    /\ liveWorkers' = {j}
    /\ timeoutRef' = j
    /\ liveTimers' = {j}
    /\ handlers' = handlers \cup {j}
    /\ posted' = posted \cup {j}
    /\ lastEvent' = "compile"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, cancellations, cleanupUsed, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

Cancel ==
    /\ cancellations < MaxCancels
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ cancellations' = cancellations + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ lastEvent' = "cancel"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, started, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

DeliverOutcome(j, k) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ (k \in {"workerError", "timeout"} \/ j \in posted)
    /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
    /\ (DeliveryPolicy # "guarded" \/ endings[j] = 0)
    /\ (SetupPolicy # "report" \/ j \notin setupFailed)
    /\ endings[j] < 2
    /\ status' = IF k = "done" THEN "done" ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "error"
    /\ resultJob' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultJob
    /\ resultSource' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultSource
    /\ failureJob' = IF k = "done" THEN failureJob ELSE j
    /\ failureSource' = IF k = "done" THEN failureSource ELSE j
    /\ failureKind' = IF k = "done" THEN failureKind ELSE Kind(k)
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

IgnoreOutcome(j, k) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ (k \in {"workerError", "timeout"} \/ j \in posted)
    /\ (jobGeneration[j] # generation \/ (DeliveryPolicy = "guarded" /\ endings[j] > 0) \/ (SetupPolicy = "report" /\ j \in setupFailed))
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = IF jobGeneration[j] # generation THEN "stale" ELSE "duplicate"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

WrongEnvelope(j) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ lastEvent' = "mismatch"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

\* Advancing the installed timer is a system scheduler step, not a demand
\* for a user or worker to respond. It models eventual delivery of the deadline.
Timeout(j) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ timeoutRef = j
    /\ j \in liveTimers
    /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
    /\ endings[j] = 0
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ status' = "timeout"
    /\ resultJob' = resultJob
    /\ resultSource' = resultSource
    /\ failureJob' = j
    /\ failureSource' = j
    /\ failureKind' = "timeout"
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = "timeout"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

DeadlineFairness == \A j \in Jobs : WF_vars(Timeout(j))

Cleanup ==
    /\ ~cleanupUsed
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ cleanupUsed' = TRUE
    /\ lastEvent' = "cleanup"
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, started, cancellations, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

\* Finite exploration may stop taking public calls; timers still have fairness.
Quiesce == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ (\E j \in Jobs : Compile(j) \/ WrongEnvelope(j) \/ Timeout(j))
    \/ (\E j \in Jobs, k \in Outcomes : DeliverOutcome(j, k) \/ IgnoreOutcome(j, k))
    \/ Cancel
    \/ Cleanup
    \/ Quiesce

\* Mutations exercise trace monitors and resource observations, not real code.
ApplyStaleCallback ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ jobGeneration[j] # generation
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ endings[j] < 2
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveTimers' = {}
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

AcceptWrongEnvelope ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ j \in posted
        /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
        /\ endings[j] = 0
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveTimers' = {}
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = staleChanged
        /\ mismatchChanged' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, overlapSeen>>

SpawnBeforeTerminate ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j = started + 1
        /\ liveWorkers # {}
        /\ generation' = generation + 1
        /\ started' = j
        /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
        /\ status' = "compiling"
        /\ failureJob' = 0
        /\ failureSource' = 0
        /\ failureKind' = "none"
        /\ workerRef' = j
        /\ liveWorkers' = {j}
        /\ timeoutRef' = j
        /\ liveTimers' = {j}
        /\ handlers' = handlers \cup {j}
        /\ posted' = posted \cup {j}
        /\ lastEvent' = "compile"
        /\ overlapSeen' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, cancellations, cleanupUsed, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged>>

CancelKeepsFailure ==
    /\ cancellations < MaxCancels
    /\ failureJob # 0
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ cancellations' = cancellations + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failureJob' = failureJob
    /\ failureSource' = failureSource
    /\ failureKind' = failureKind
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ lastEvent' = "cancel"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, started, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

FinishWithoutClearingTimer ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
        /\ endings[j] = 0
        /\ timeoutRef = j
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = timeoutRef
        /\ liveTimers' = liveTimers
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = staleChanged
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

---- MODULE LatestCompile ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxJobs, MaxCancels, MaxDeliveries
VARIABLES status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent

vars == <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen, lastEvent>>

\* This is an UNRATIFIED, bounded, per-fork candidate for the unchanged hook.
\* An action is one synchronous public call or callback, after React updates flush.
\* Worker construction/termination and timer installation/clearing are recorded
\* inside that action. overlapSeen records even a transient overlap of workers.
\* A driver assigns each compile a distinct source and payload tag j.
\* resultJob/resultSource and failureJob/failureSource are those observed tags;
\* zero denotes null. Results persist across compile, cancel, and failures.
\* generation and jobGeneration are the observed ref and captured closure IDs.
\* endings counts terminal updates, deliveries counts invoked terminal callbacks,
\* and handlers/posted record which callbacks exist and which workers got input.
\* staleChanged and mismatchChanged are trace monitors: compare status, result
\* and failure before/after an invalid callback; once a change occurs, retain it.
\* liveWorkers/liveTimers track actual resources, independently of the refs.
\* MaxDeliveries bounds terminal-callback invocations PER job, not invalid-envelope
\* messages. One delivery in F2/F3 isolates those forks without deciding F1.
\* Cleanup and synchronous setup exceptions are absent unless that fork models
\* them. Such partial previews do not settle either of the other questions.
\* Illustrated option: F3/A; no other unanswered fork is chosen.

DeliveryPolicy == "prefix"
CleanupPolicy == "omitted"
SetupPolicy == "propagate"

Jobs == 1..MaxJobs
MaxGeneration == MaxJobs + MaxCancels + 1
Statuses == {"idle", "compiling", "done", "error", "timeout"}
Outcomes == {"done", "compileError", "environmentError", "workerError", "timeout"}
Events == Outcomes \cup {"init", "compile", "cancel", "cleanup", "stale", "duplicate", "mismatch", "constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
Kind(k) == IF k = "compileError" THEN "compile" ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "environment"

CurrentExists == \E j \in 1..started : jobGeneration[j] = generation
CurrentPending ==
    IF started = 0 THEN FALSE
    ELSE jobGeneration[started] = generation /\ endings[started] = 0 /\ started \notin setupFailed

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in Statuses
    /\ resultJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ resultSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureJob \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureSource \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ failureKind \in {"none", "compile", "environment", "timeout"}
    /\ generation \in 0..MaxGeneration
    /\ started \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ cancellations \in 0..MaxCancels
    /\ cleanupUsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ jobGeneration \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxGeneration]
    /\ handlers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ posted \subseteq Jobs
    /\ workerRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveWorkers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ timeoutRef \in 0..MaxJobs
    /\ liveTimers \subseteq Jobs
    /\ endings \in [Jobs -> 0..2]
    /\ deliveries \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxDeliveries]
    /\ released \subseteq Jobs
    /\ setupFailed \subseteq Jobs
    /\ staleChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ mismatchChanged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ overlapSeen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ lastEvent \in Events

LatestOutcomeOnly == ~staleChanged
MatchingMessageOnly == ~mismatchChanged
OneLiveWorker == ~overlapSeen /\ Cardinality(liveWorkers) <= 1
StoppedHasNoWorker == status # "compiling" => liveWorkers = {}
EndedTimerCleared == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0 => j \notin liveTimers /\ timeoutRef # j
CancellationIsIdle ==
    (cancellations > 0 \/ (CleanupPolicy = "cancel" /\ cleanupUsed)) /\ ~CurrentExists
    => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ failureSource = 0 /\ failureKind = "none"
ResourceRefsMatch ==
    /\ liveWorkers = (IF workerRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {workerRef})
    /\ liveTimers = (IF timeoutRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {timeoutRef})
PayloadSourcesMatch ==
    /\ resultSource = resultJob
    /\ failureSource = failureJob
    /\ (failureJob = 0) = (failureKind = "none")
ExactlyOneEnding == \A j \in Jobs : endings[j] <= 1
CleanupCancels ==
    lastEvent = "cleanup" => status = "idle" /\ failureJob = 0 /\ ~CurrentExists
SetupErrorsReported ==
    /\ lastEvent \in {"constructorThrow", "postThrow"}
       => status = "error" /\ failureJob = started /\ failureKind = "environment"
          /\ workerRef = 0 /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ \A j \in setupFailed : endings[j] = 1

UnreplacedEventuallyEnds ==
    \A j \in Jobs :
        (j <= started /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation /\ endings[j] = 0
         /\ j \notin released /\ j \notin setupFailed)
        ~> (endings[j] > 0 \/ jobGeneration[j] # generation
            \/ j \in released \/ j \in setupFailed)

CanCompile == status = "compiling" /\ workerRef # 0 /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanSucceed == status = "done" /\ resultJob # 0
CanFailCompilation == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "compile"
CanFailEnvironment == status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanTimeOut == status = "timeout" /\ failureKind = "timeout"
CanCancel == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ handlers # {}
CanReplace == started = MaxJobs /\ status = "compiling"
CanIgnoreStale == lastEvent = "stale"
CanIgnoreMismatch == lastEvent = "mismatch"
CanRetainResult == status = "compiling" /\ resultJob > 0 /\ resultJob < started
CanCancelAfterFailure == status = "idle" /\ cancellations > 0 /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] > 0
CanIgnoreDuplicate == lastEvent = "duplicate" /\ \E j \in Jobs : endings[j] = 1
CanAbandonOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "compiling" /\ released # {} /\ liveTimers = {}
CanApplyAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ status = "done" /\ resultJob \in released
CanCancelOnCleanup == lastEvent = "cleanup" /\ status = "idle" /\ handlers # {} /\ ~CurrentExists
CanRejectAfterCleanup == cleanupUsed /\ lastEvent = "stale" /\ cancellations = 0 /\ started = 1
CanThrowConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ started \in setupFailed /\ workerRef = 0
CanThrowPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "compiling" /\ timeoutRef # 0
CanTimeOutAfterPostThrow == status = "timeout" /\ failureJob \in handlers \ posted
CanReportConstruction == lastEvent = "constructorThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"
CanReportPost == lastEvent = "postThrow" /\ status = "error" /\ failureKind = "environment"

Init ==
    /\ status = "idle"
    /\ resultJob = 0
    /\ resultSource = 0
    /\ failureJob = 0
    /\ failureSource = 0
    /\ failureKind = "none"
    /\ generation = 0
    /\ started = 0
    /\ cancellations = 0
    /\ cleanupUsed = FALSE
    /\ jobGeneration = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ handlers = {}
    /\ posted = {}
    /\ workerRef = 0
    /\ liveWorkers = {}
    /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ liveTimers = {}
    /\ endings = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ deliveries = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ released = {}
    /\ setupFailed = {}
    /\ staleChanged = FALSE
    /\ mismatchChanged = FALSE
    /\ overlapSeen = FALSE
    /\ lastEvent = "init"

Compile(j) ==
    /\ j = started + 1
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ started' = j
    /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
    /\ status' = "compiling"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ workerRef' = j
    /\ liveWorkers' = {j}
    /\ timeoutRef' = j
    /\ liveTimers' = {j}
    /\ handlers' = handlers \cup {j}
    /\ posted' = posted \cup {j}
    /\ lastEvent' = "compile"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, cancellations, cleanupUsed, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

Cancel ==
    /\ cancellations < MaxCancels
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ cancellations' = cancellations + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ lastEvent' = "cancel"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, started, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

DeliverOutcome(j, k) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ (k \in {"workerError", "timeout"} \/ j \in posted)
    /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
    /\ (DeliveryPolicy # "guarded" \/ endings[j] = 0)
    /\ (SetupPolicy # "report" \/ j \notin setupFailed)
    /\ endings[j] < 2
    /\ status' = IF k = "done" THEN "done" ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "error"
    /\ resultJob' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultJob
    /\ resultSource' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE resultSource
    /\ failureJob' = IF k = "done" THEN failureJob ELSE j
    /\ failureSource' = IF k = "done" THEN failureSource ELSE j
    /\ failureKind' = IF k = "done" THEN failureKind ELSE Kind(k)
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

IgnoreOutcome(j, k) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ (k \in {"workerError", "timeout"} \/ j \in posted)
    /\ (jobGeneration[j] # generation \/ (DeliveryPolicy = "guarded" /\ endings[j] > 0) \/ (SetupPolicy = "report" /\ j \in setupFailed))
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = IF jobGeneration[j] # generation THEN "stale" ELSE "duplicate"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

WrongEnvelope(j) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ lastEvent' = "mismatch"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, workerRef, liveWorkers, timeoutRef, liveTimers, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

\* Advancing the installed timer is a system scheduler step, not a demand
\* for a user or worker to respond. It models eventual delivery of the deadline.
Timeout(j) ==
    /\ j \in handlers
    /\ timeoutRef = j
    /\ j \in liveTimers
    /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
    /\ endings[j] = 0
    /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
    /\ status' = "timeout"
    /\ resultJob' = resultJob
    /\ resultSource' = resultSource
    /\ failureJob' = j
    /\ failureSource' = j
    /\ failureKind' = "timeout"
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
    /\ lastEvent' = "timeout"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

DeadlineFairness == \A j \in Jobs : WF_vars(Timeout(j))

ConstructorThrows(j) ==
    /\ j = started + 1
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ started' = j
    /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveTimers' = {}
    /\ lastEvent' = "constructorThrow"
    /\ setupFailed' = setupFailed \cup {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, resultJob, resultSource, failureJob, failureSource, failureKind, cancellations, cleanupUsed, handlers, posted, endings, deliveries, released, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

PostThrows(j) ==
    /\ j = started + 1
    /\ generation' = generation + 1
    /\ started' = j
    /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
    /\ status' = "compiling"
    /\ failureJob' = 0
    /\ failureSource' = 0
    /\ failureKind' = "none"
    /\ workerRef' = j
    /\ liveWorkers' = {j}
    /\ timeoutRef' = j
    /\ liveTimers' = {j}
    /\ handlers' = handlers \cup {j}
    /\ posted' = posted
    /\ lastEvent' = "postThrow"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resultJob, resultSource, cancellations, cleanupUsed, endings, deliveries, released, setupFailed, staleChanged, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

\* Finite exploration may stop taking public calls; timers still have fairness.
Quiesce == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ (\E j \in Jobs : Compile(j) \/ WrongEnvelope(j) \/ Timeout(j) \/ ConstructorThrows(j) \/ PostThrows(j))
    \/ (\E j \in Jobs, k \in Outcomes : DeliverOutcome(j, k) \/ IgnoreOutcome(j, k))
    \/ Cancel
    \/ Quiesce

\* Mutations exercise trace monitors and resource observations, not real code.
ApplyStaleCallback ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ jobGeneration[j] # generation
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ endings[j] < 2
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveTimers' = {}
        /\ endings' = [endings EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, mismatchChanged, overlapSeen>>

        /\ j \in handlers
        /\ j \in posted
        /\ jobGeneration[j] = generation
        /\ endings[j] = 0
        /\ deliveries[j] < MaxDeliveries
        /\ status' = "done"
        /\ resultJob' = j
        /\ resultSource' = j
        /\ failureJob' = failureJob
        /\ failureSource' = failureSource
        /\ failureKind' = failureKind
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveTimers' = {}

        /\ deliveries' = [deliveries EXCEPT ![j] = @ + 1]
        /\ lastEvent' = "done"
        /\ staleChanged' = staleChanged
        /\ mismatchChanged' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<generation, started, cancellations, cleanupUsed, jobGeneration, handlers, posted, released, setupFailed, overlapSeen>>

SpawnBeforeTerminate ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ j = started + 1
        /\ liveWorkers # {}
        /\ generation' = generation + 1
        /\ started' = j
        /\ jobGeneration' = [jobGeneration EXCEPT ![j] = generation + 1]
        /\ status' = "compiling"
        /\ failureJob' = 0
        /\ failureSource' = 0
        /\ failureKind' = "none"
        /\ workerRef' = j
        /\ liveWorkers' = {j}
        /\ timeoutRef' = j
        /\ liveTimers' = {j}
        /\ handlers' = handlers \cup {j}
        /\ posted' = posted \cup {j}
        /\ lastEvent' = "compile"

    /\ status' = "idle"

    /\ workerRef' = 0
